experiences.organization: Hoki Jaya Motor, Damay Musik & Project DMP

en: Grew Hoki Jaya Motor TikTok (@hjm_hokijayamotor) and Instagram (@hokijaya_motor) from 0 to 120K+ followers and 5M+ organic views through retention-led short-form video.
Launched and produced multi-cam music sessions for Damay Musik Subang and Project DMP from scratch to full YouTube monetization.
Executed solo end-to-end production as well as coordinated multi-person filming and post-production schedules.
id: Membangun akun TikTok (@hjm_hokijayamotor) & Instagram (@hokijaya_motor) Hoki Jaya Motor dari 0 hingga 120K+ followers dan 5 Juta+ views organik.
Merintis dan memproduksi sesi musik multi-kamera untuk Damay Musik Subang & Project DMP dari nol hingga sukses termonetisasi di YouTube.
Mampu mengeksekusi proyek secara solo end-to-end maupun memimpin tim produksi.

en: Integrated AI tools including ElevenLabs, Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Hermes Agent into daily media workflows and rapid web prototyping.
Built functional personal web applications (including bilingual study tools and modular portfolio systems) without relying on heavy manual boilerplate.
id: Mengintegrasikan ElevenLabs, Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, dan Hermes Agent ke dalam alur kerja media serta pembuatan aplikasi web cepat.
Membangun web app fungsional secara mandiri (termasuk sistem belajar dan portofolio modular) berbasis workflow agentic AI.

en: Operated OBS Studio and TikTok Live Studio setups for stable multi-scene commercial broadcasts.
Hosted on-camera live sessions focused on real-time audience Q&A and direct product conversion.
id: Mengelola setup teknis siaran langsung multi-scene menggunakan OBS Studio dan TikTok Live Studio.
Membawakan sesi live on-camera untuk interaksi audiens langsung dan dorongan konversi penjualan.

en: Planned community retention events and promotional campaigns to maintain healthy daily active user participation.
Monitored server uptime, resolved member disputes, and coordinated moderation guidelines.
id: Merancang kampanye promosi dan event komunitas untuk menjaga pertumbuhan pengguna aktif.
Memantau stabilitas operasional server dan menangani dukungan anggota komunitas secara responsif.

en: Delivered commercial and entertainment video edits in Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut under tight turnaround schedules.
Handled rough cuts, audio-video synchronization, pacing, and color correction.
id: Menyelesaikan editing video komersial dan hiburan dengan tenggat ketat menggunakan Adobe Premiere Pro dan CapCut.
Menangani raw cutting, sinkronisasi audio, ritme visual, hingga color grading.

en: Operated Studio One DAW for vocal tracking, multi-track mixing, noise cleanup, and final mastering.
Produced original instrumental arrangements tailored to client branding briefs.
id: Mengoperasikan Studio One DAW untuk rekaman vokal, mixing multi-track, dan mastering audio.
Membuat aransemen instrumen orisinal sesuai kebutuhan branding klien.

en: Photographed traditional weddings and outdoor pre-wedding sessions managing lighting and framing.
Delivered curated high-resolution galleries retouched in Adobe Lightroom.
id: Mendokumentasikan acara pernikahan dan sesi pre-wedding outdoor dengan tata cahaya dan komposisi rapi.
Menyunting dan meretouch galeri foto resolusi tinggi menggunakan Adobe Lightroom.
